chitchat: Bland sits very still with a paper cup of water in both hands.
He stretches his hamstrings, one leg and then the other, counting under his breath.
He reads the back of a cereal box all the way to the end.
He tapes his stick slowly, each turn laid exactly over the last.
He yawns and checks the time.
He signs a programme somebody has left out, carefully, his full name.
description: A tall, slim man of about twenty-two in a navy Marauders tracksuit zipped to the chin and white trainers. His hair is cut short and neat. He holds a paper cup of water in both hands and doesn't drink from it.

club.text:
"They're good lads. Grubb looks after everyone. He looks after me most, because I'm the youngest and I forget to eat."

"We share a flat in Chrome Court. It's one room. He has the bed and I have the floor, but I've got a good mat." He thinks. "The building's all mirrors outside. Our window looks at a brick wall. I like that, actually. There's nothing to look at."

"I don't like the Yard Birds. Their rooster goes for my ankles."

role.text:
"There's a poster of me on the Marquee, outside a club. It's three floors high. They made my eyes blue. My eyes are brown." He points at one, so you can see.

"People shout my name in the street. I don't mind. I go to bed at nine, so mostly they shout it in the morning. Grubb says I should go out more, for the fans. I went once. It was loud and the water was eight credits."

options.label: Everybody says you're the one to watch.
What's it like, dying out there?

text: "Hello." He waits to see if there's more.
"Hi. Sorry, were you waiting for me?"

familiar: "Hi! I was hoping it'd be you."
text_by_relation.first: "Hi. I'm Dequarius Bland. I play on the wing for the Marauders. People say I'm the star. I just shoot it at the net."

season.text: He thinks about it properly. "${npc.cphl.season} I think that's right. Grubb writes it down, so you could ask him." He looks into his cup. "I don't really count. I go out and do the next shift, and then I come home and go to bed."

vat.text:
"It's fine. You go cold, and then you're in the vat, and it's warm." He shrugs. "They give you a cup of something sweet when you come out. I like that part."

"The first time, I was scared I'd come back worse at hockey. I didn't. I came back a bit better, actually. I don't know why. Grubb says don't tell anyone."
